definition: Deliberate resurrection after a gap: the style brings back one that had fallen out of use, as Colonial Revival brought back Georgian after some sixty years. A revival is a claim, not a transmission, and passes on no part of the kit.
more: Colonial Revival knew its ancestor at first only through anecdote, ruin and bad engraving. Its actual line of practice runs through the Shingle Style offices and through Beaux-Arts training, which it descends from; the Georgian house is the ancestor it claims.
